title: M5-T173 part B3 (M5-T193) - page-6 scenario sheet: the embedded two-zone area illustration with one caption carrying the document's areas and footprint basis, the section with height-limit lines, a reconciled floor schedule and a short unresolved list; every drawn/placed claim takes an explicit flag
objective: (1) NEW report/scenario_figures.py: embed_area_illustration(building, *, env) calls kit.area_allocation.draw_area_allocation(block, placement=building['placement'], caption=False) behind kit.flag.drawing_kit_enabled and returns a drawings_embed.Embedded (an Unavailable becomes its reason verbatim); embed_section(building, results, *, env) calls kit.render_floor_stack with results= only when its signature has that keyword (part B2), else drawings_embed.embed_floor_stack; embed_scenario_drawings(results, *, env) returns both per worked building for part W. (2) report/page_scenario_sheet.py render(results, ident, *, env=None, drawings=None, footprint_drawn=None); drawings None embeds itself. Area illustration under the section/text row with ONE figcaption: the caption token, then 'apartment area {apartment_area_sqft} sq ft; other building area {other_area_sqft} sq ft; of {total_sqft} sq ft residential floor area; footprint on the {placement.basis in words}' from document fields with the existing formatting (no percentage, no second sentence). Section caption: height lines drawn gives 'Section (Illustrative): storeys from the floor schedule; height limits from the permitted envelope (Conditional).'; footprint_drawn True drops the 'no placement on the lot' clause; otherwise today's text. Placement line: building_not_placed(results) keeps NOT_PLACED_LINE; placement.status 'placed' with floor_plates available and footprint_drawn False gives 'The footprint is worked out but is not drawn in this report.'; True or None gives nothing. Schedule: 'Plan area' relabelled as zoning floor area per storey; the document's conversion statement once on the page (inside the illustration when drawn, else one footnote under the schedule); the note 'Storey areas are shown rounded; the running total adds the unrounded areas.' only when the shown storey figures do not add to the shown total. Unresolved: 'Unresolved for this building' (Pending verification chip) = building.not_checked plus placement.not_checked, de-duplicated case-insensitively in document order, then one line linking the appendix open items by number (readers.open_items anchors). The estimate at page_scenario_sheet.py:117-126 stays. No new sentence of 8 or more words repeats one printed elsewhere.
business_reason: Audit 2026-10-15c sections 3-4: page 6 shows a generic stack 'with no placement on the lot'; 12,090/8,060 sq ft appear nowhere; one unchecked item shown of the placement's six; 3 x 6,716.67 shown against 20,150 with no reconciliation.
